product_metadata.title: Weighmax Dream Series Digital Pocket Scale, 100 by 0.01 g, Rasta
features: Weighmax 2015 Newest Dream Color Series Digital Pocket scale in Rasta Coating Finish with Clear cover
Weigh up to 100 grams in 0.01 gram increments
Weighing modes: g, oz, ozt, ct
Easy to read, back-lit LCD display; Clear cover can work as a weighing tray
Powered by 2 AAA batteries, a set of which comes included
description: Weighmax Newest 2015 Newest Dream Color Series Digital Pocket scale is finally lunched. This gorgeous scale is finished with Unique Rasta coating. It is sleek and portable, weighing from 0.01g to 100g. The scale comes with a clear cover which can be used as a weighing tray. Scale comes with 2 AAA batteries. It is ready to use right out of box..
